question: What enclosure composed of paired eternal letters should be remembered?
premises: The object of remembrance is an enclosure.
It is composed of letters of paired eternals.
It is identified as the ghaṭikā enclosure.
inference: One should remember the ghaṭikā enclosure composed of the letters of the paired eternals.
uncertainties: The exact meaning of yuga-nityā in this context is interpretive.
plain_english: One should remember the ghaṭikā enclosure, composed of the letters of the paired eternals.
